15.t: Working with data: a family survey
q: For condition P, how many children did not have it?
Calculate the fraction of children with P.
Suggest whether P is dominant or recessive, with a reason.
Dominant: two affected parents had unaffected children (1 in 4), so both parents were heterozygous.
Q: every child was affected. R: no child was affected. Explain each.
Q fits a recessive condition: affected parents are both qq, so all children are qq. R cannot be inherited simply; it may be caused by the environment or new mutations.
